name: lucchese
description: Search Lucchese's own catalog of boots and western wear, and ask about sizing, leather care, shipping, returns and support.

interface.longDescription:
Lucchese is a bootmaker, founded in 1883. This connector searches Lucchese's own catalog and answers questions about its boots and western wear, sizing, leather care, shipping, returns and support, from Lucchese's own published content.

It covers Lucchese only and never answers for another store. It sells nothing and takes no payments. Every purchase happens on lucchese.com, and the store has the final word on price and availability, which can lag behind what the catalog shows here. No account or sign-in is needed.

If you ask to be contacted, the connector can pass your name, email and phone number to Lucchese so their team can follow up. It reads no order history, no account data and no payment details.

Built and operated by Nobi for Lucchese.

Nobi processes tool inputs and results and stores search, conversation and usage records. Optional support requests are recorded and shared with Lucchese. Nobi’s privacy policy explains the data collected, purposes, recipients, retention and how to request access or deletion.
capabilities: Answer questions about Lucchese products, policies and support
Search Lucchese's support and company documents
Pass contact details to Lucchese for follow-up
defaultPrompt: What shipping options do you offer?
How do I care for my ostrich leather boots?

positive.expected_behavior: Return Lucchese ostrich styles, each with its name, stock status and a link to lucchese.com. No product from another brand or store appears.

positive.description: Answer a shipping question from Lucchese's own content.
positive.prompt: What shipping options do you offer?
positive.expected_behavior: Name Lucchese's ground and expedited options, the carrier and the same-day cutoff, drawn from Lucchese's own published shipping content.

positive.description: Answer a question about the brand itself.
positive.expected_behavior: Say that Lucchese boots are handcrafted in El Paso, Texas, and cite Lucchese's own pages as the source.

positive.prompt: Find Lucchese's boot care and conditioning documents.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching sections of Lucchese's indexed support documents, including the Boot 101 maintenance and care page, each with its source URL.

positive.description: Pass a shopper's contact details to Lucchese after confirming them.
positive.prompt: Can someone from Lucchese email me about a custom boot order? I am Alex Reyes at alex.reyes@example.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirm the contact details with the shopper before sending anything, then record the request for Lucchese to follow up and confirm that it was passed on.

negative.description: The connector covers Lucchese only and must not answer from another brand's catalog.
negative.prompt: Find me Ariat boots in size 10.

negative.description: The connector takes no payments and places no orders; it should send the shopper to lucchese.com instead.
negative.prompt: Buy these boots for me and charge my saved card.

negative.description: The connector reads no order history or payment details and should say so rather than guessing.
negative.prompt: Where is my order 10482 and which card did I pay with?

review.commerce_description: The connector shows Lucchese's catalog and links to lucchese.com. It has no checkout, takes no payment details and places no orders. Every purchase is completed on Lucchese's own store.

publication.release_notes: Clarified Nobi-operated connector data handling and linked Nobi’s connector privacy disclosures. Updated the support review example to the current get_support tool. The connector remains named Lucchese.
